newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dangerous Danish cargo held in Marseille.
newsitem.headline: Dangerous Danish cargo held in Marseille.

text.p: A Danish vessel with a cargo that has become dangerous has been ordered to remain at anchor off the French Mediterranean port of Fos-sur-Mer, near Marseille, harbour officials said on Friday.

The Tiger was caught in a storm off the French Atlantic coast last week carrying a cargo of explosive powder for vehicle airbags which became soaked with seawater and began releasing potentially fatal toxic gases, the officials said.
Experts told harbour authorities that the cargo would have to be unloaded by specially equipped crews and destroyed before the Tiger could leave port again, the officials told Reuters.
There were no reports of injuries during the incident.
